overview: Polish shell/setup/demo entry surfaces with consistent state clarity, action hierarchy, and deterministic error behavior while minimizing overlap with detail-surface edits.
goals: Standardize loading/empty/blocked/success state treatment on entry surfaces.
Improve CTA hierarchy and interaction accessibility for shell/setup/demo flows.
Align deterministic error/support behavior with 0009f contracts.
Limit scope to route-aligned files to reduce merge conflicts.
successMetrics: Shell/setup/demo state scenarios pass deterministic guidance checks.
Keyboard/touch accessibility checks pass for critical entry-surface actions.
Error/support behavior matches 0009f across touched surfaces.

routes.name: Matters Shell
routes.purpose: Primary shell and setup polish scope.

routes.name: Matter Entry Panels
routes.purpose: Demo/setup entry modules only; no detail-surface tab polish.

uiNotes: Keep state and action treatments deterministic and source-backed.
rules: One clear primary action per entry context.
Retry and support behavior must follow 0009f envelope rules.
No hardcoded trust claims or unsupported capability text.

stories.title: Shell/setup/demo state clarity sweep
stories.description: As an operator, I want deterministic state messaging so I know what to do next on entry surfaces.
acceptanceCriteria: Loading/empty/blocked/success states on shell/setup/demo provide explicit guidance.
Example: blocked setup state includes one explicit recovery path.
Negative: no spinner-only or blank states without context.

stories.title: Entry-surface hierarchy and accessibility polish
stories.description: As an operator, I want clear action hierarchy and keyboard/touch access in shell/setup/demo flows.
acceptanceCriteria: Each context has one clear primary action with secondary alternatives.
Example: setup panel presents one primary next action and secondary help options.
Negative: no required action discoverable only by hover.

stories.title: Error/support consistency on entry surfaces
stories.description: As an operator, I want error and escalation behavior to remain predictable on shell/setup/demo surfaces.
acceptanceCriteria: ErrorBanner field mapping and retry/support gating match 0009f.
Example: retry appears only when retryable=true.
Negative: no dead-end disabled support action without fallback guidance.
